description: This file defines a provider for indexing Boolean fields in OrchardCore content items using YesSql. It includes classes for the index and the index provider, with logic to identify and index BooleanField instances within content types.

classes.name: BooleanFieldIndex
classes.description: Represents an index for Boolean fields within content items, storing the Boolean value and related metadata.

classes.name: BooleanFieldIndexProvider
classes.description: Provides indexing logic for BooleanField instances in content items, including filtering and mapping logic.

methods.name: Describe
methods.description: Defines how content items are mapped to BooleanFieldIndex during indexing, including filtering out deleted or irrelevant items.
